operatorPreflightIssues.issue: JDK parent directory was initially used instead of versioned JDK Contents/Home; corrected before Gradle launched. Not a model or compiler failure.
Context assembly first looked for gradle.log instead of build.log; initial harness invocation stopped before Codex because context.txt was absent. Corrected file lookup before actual turn.

result: Bounded experiment finished with a compiling smaller primitive prototype. No full-museum parity, verified Free ChatGPT session or native runtime proof.
knownLimits: No runtime render,window closure,reopening,gesture,room entry or exit evidence.
15 extra catalogue exhibits are generic box/cylinder stand-ins; all 18 room objects are generic primitives.
Catalogue main controls lie below the scrolling exhibit list; actual reachability and layout need native review.
Three stories use discrete timed pose changes,not polished animation. Playback coroutine is owned by main view; companion-only playback after closing main is not established.
Shared store tests validate data reads and writes,not actual Compose recomposition or Activity lifecycle.
Room has plinth positions but no room-specific unit tests,spatial exhibit selection,art,wall environment or navigation.
Fresh-machine setup,offline dependency reproduction and Free ChatGPT quota/context limits were not tested.
Focused review: the generated Companion inspector panel is text/buttons only, without its own SpatialView or independent rotation. The original independent 3D inspector was not reproduced.
The prototype supplies generic three-step placeholder stories for the extra fifteen catalogue entries; this differs from the original museum, where only the initial three objects have stories.
